name: crow_of_dark_tidings_mills_two_entering_and_two_dying
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters or dies, mill two cards.' Seat 0 casts Crow of Dark Tidings: it enters and seat 0 mills two (Library 5, Library 4). The Crow then dies: seat 0 mills two more (Library 3, Library 2). Seat 0's graveyard: the Crow and four milled cards; the opponent mills nothing.
